summary: RLX Technology Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting its unaudited Q2 2026 financial results, including net revenues of RMB1,010.5 million, a 14.8% year-over-year increase, and US GAAP net income of RMB222.0 million. The press release, signed by CFO Chao Lu, discusses operational highlights and notes a July 2026 acquisition of a 51% equity interest in a Western European distributor, but no deal terms, price, or premium are disclosed. This is a routine earnings announcement, not a special-situation event. The acquisition reference is forward-looking commentary within results, not the subject of the filing.
